quest.title: Lion's Celerity
quest.description: You've recovered Zeitlind's lost belongings and liberated the three areas, but the problem is far from resolved...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x50, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

chapter.num: A Long Day in the Mountains: Chapter 2
chapter.title: Hell

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh! Where did you two go just now? Paimon nearly had a heart attack there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon was calling your names the whole time!

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Hmm? Why wasn't Paimon dragged into the Apathic Interval?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well... maybe because other than eating and sleeping...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She doesn't really think about much at all?

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Hmm. Makes sense.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Looks like Melanta really is angry now.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: #Sending {NICKNAME} up to face him has become urgent.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Let's talk somewhere else. This place isn't exactly safe anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Alara
dialogues.text: Um, well, I know no one asked, but... Hello, everyone. My name is Alara.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Once more, we return to this place...

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: The last time I came, by human lifespans, it must have been... many, many, many... generations ago.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Looks like we've all been cast back into the Apathic Interval.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So how are we supposed to get out?

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: The usual way is through meditation — learning to master your mind and thoughts, and then letting go of every desire.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: In short, we must maintain a state of complete emptiness.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Simply enough said. But depending on a person's nature and the strength of their desires, it can take anywhere from a few years to several centuries.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: For someone like you who carries the fate of the world on your shoulders, your desires probably can't be cast aside... nor should they be.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then what do we do?

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Let's find Zeitlind, and figure it out from there.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What'd you pick up?

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Wait, Dex was dragged in as well?

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: In that case, there may yet be a chance to turn this around.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Since Dex is also a Watcher, it might be able to use the power contained within these fragments to force open a path.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: We're going to need to give these fragments a name.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: I've heard of these overwrought coffins. They were set up by one of the temple mistress's sisters... Maranasati Caskets, I believe they were called.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: In which case, let's call the fragments Deathmuse Shards.

talks.objective: Use Dex's ability to clear a path
Return to the center of the Pillar Hall

dialogues.speaker: Melanta
dialogues.text: You observe in stillness — notice how thoughts arise, and how the mind works...
